qc.label_under_test: a short word-initial piece (' inc', ' conc', ' enc', ' ecc', ' vic') that opens a longer Latinate word split by the tokenizer (inc|andescent, conc|ierge, enc|ircle), as against whole-token words with the same opening (income, concise, encounter, vicinity)

neighbours.label: an unfinished word-opening piece that ends in the letter c (inc, conc, acc, prec, succ, ecc, vic), cut mid-word with the rest of the word in a later token; not whole words (income, concise, access) and not non-c fragments
fire: Her eccentricities made her the most memorable professor in the department.
The lawyer gave a succinctly worded summary of the case.
He tried to concoct a believable excuse for missing the meeting.
The precociousness of the young violinist astonished the judges.
After the fever, his speech became incoherently rambling.
The vicissitudes of farming life taught them patience.
Interest will slowly accrete in the dormant account over the decades.
The old lamp glowed with an incandescently bright filament.
quiet: Her strange habits made her the most memorable professor in the department.
The lawyer gave a brief summary of the case.
He tried to invent a believable excuse for missing the meeting.
The talent of the young violinist astonished the judges.
After the fever, his speech became slurred and rambling.
The ups and downs of farming life taught them patience.
Interest will slowly build in the dormant account over the decades.
The old lamp glowed with a bright filament.

predictions: Expect most fire sentences to hold (inc, succ, conc, vic, ecc pieces); risk: accrete / precocious may be whole tokens or split elsewhere. About 6/8 fire, 0 near misses.
